Balance change chart. Explore its values using the previous and next entry buttons below.
Open is the previous recorded value; Close is the selected value. No highs, lows, or shadows are invented.
Percentage is undefined when the previous value is zero.
Percentages compare change with the magnitude of the previous value, including negative values.

UTF-8 CSV with date,value columns. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD; values use a decimal point. Export before changing or uninstalling the app.
Valid entries: %1$d. Invalid or repeated rows: %2$d.
Repeated dates in the file keep the first valid row. Invalid rows are never written.

Repeated date; the first valid row is kept.
Dates migrated: %1$d. Invalid or unmatched rows: %2$d. Repeated dates: %3$d. Existing dates kept: %4$d.
The latest valid value for each date was migrated. Every original slot is kept privately, including rows that could not be paired. Export the original records to recover or inspect them.

Records and settings live in this app’s private device storage. The app has no network access, analytics, or ads. Automatic backup and device transfer are excluded. Files leave the app only when you choose to export them.
Dates use the Gregorian calendar in both languages. Their stored dates stay the same when you change languages or time zones.
